verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents its own export feature with open, readable options (an unencrypted ZIP or a CSV) so users can take their data elsewhere, and it separately documents storing and generating TOTP codes. However, nothing in the evidence confirms that TOTP secrets are included in the export or how they are represented. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that TOTP secrets (e.g., otpauth URIs) are included in exports, documented import compatibility of exported TOTP data with other authenticator apps, independent or hands-on corroboration of a full TOTP migration out.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in

citations.quote: If you want to use your passwords elsewhere or create a separate hardcopy, you can easily export your data from Proton Pass.
Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
